data.body:
=== BOTH CHANGES MERGED AND CONTENT VERIFIED ON gerrit/main. ===

Gerrit 1240 and 1241 both reached LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1 on the rebased patch set 3 and were
submitted. They landed as f559ba51d7 ("single-source the ticket-type map") and 12cae5fa63 ("guard the
ticket-type map like the others").

CONTENT VERIFIED ON gerrit/main RATHER THAN ASSUMED — and deliberately NOT against origin/main, which
lagged behind Gerrit at the time of checking (origin/main was 5ce20c5350 while gerrit/main was
12cae5fa63; the GitHub mirror trails the review remote, and checking the mirror first would have
looked like the work had not landed):
 * NO `_LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE` dict literal remains anywhere under `adapters/` — the duplication is gone;
 * `adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py` carries the canonical `LOCAL_TYPE_TO_JIRA`, beside
   `LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA` and `LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA` as the J2 pattern prescribes;
 * `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_family_boundary_heldout.py` carries
   `test_exactly_one_type_map_literal_within_adapters`, so a future third copy fails the build the
   same way the status and priority maps are already protected.

The rebase onto the click fix (31844d5f9fb) preserved both Change-Ids, produced no env-var registry
drift, and kept the targeted tests green (28 passed) — recorded in the earlier comment. The Verified
-1 that was briefly visible on PS3 was a vote copied forward from PS2 under the trivial-rebase copy
condition, and Gerrit withdrew it once the real runs started.

This was the LAST open P1 child of epic 3e73-72b5-cff2-40f0; cedc, 79d5 and 2944 are already closed.
